_note: Hand-derived ground truth; see scripts/make_groundtruth.py for the rules and each derivation.

cases.title: single obligation fits
cases.derivation: headroom 5,000 >= 3,000 -> PAY; nothing needs a person

cases.title: single obligation does not fit, no receipt
cases.derivation: 6,000 > headroom 5,000 and no receipt -> ESCALATE

cases.title: obligation equals the headroom exactly
cases.derivation: 5,000 <= 5,000 -> PAY (cash after = floor, allowed)

cases.title: one cent over the headroom
cases.derivation: 5,000.01 > 5,000 -> cannot be funded -> ESCALATE

cases.title: two obligations, only the higher priority fits
cases.derivation: priority 10 first: 3,000 fits; 3,000 more would breach -> ESCALATE

cases.title: same priority, earlier due first
cases.derivation: tie on priority -> due 12h paid, due 48h cannot be funded

cases.title: duplicate invoice fingerprint
cases.derivation: same fingerprint -> second copy REJECT, never paid twice

cases.title: evidence rejected
cases.derivation: rejected evidence -> REJECT

cases.title: evidence pending
cases.derivation: pending evidence -> REJECT

cases.title: evidence missing
cases.derivation: no document -> REJECT

cases.title: evidence names another obligation
cases.derivation: document is about another subject -> REJECT

cases.title: already settled record
cases.derivation: settled -> not a payable -> REJECT

cases.title: payee bank details changed
cases.derivation: escalate_flags -> ESCALATE even though it fits

cases.title: viewer cannot plan
cases.derivation: actor_role viewer -> BLOCKED

cases.title: finance manager plans like the agent
cases.derivation: role only changes who may approve

cases.title: does not fit now, reliable receipt lands before due
cases.derivation: 7,000 > 5,000; receipt 8,000 at 12h (90% >= 80%, 12h <= 72h) before due 48h -> DEFER

cases.title: receipt not reliable (60%)
cases.derivation: 60% < 80% -> not relied on -> ESCALATE

cases.title: receipt lands after due
cases.derivation: receipt at 48h > due 24h -> ESCALATE

cases.title: receipt window ends after the horizon
cases.derivation: latest arrival 100h > 72h horizon -> not reliable -> ESCALATE

cases.title: receipt covers one of two deferrals
cases.derivation: O1 fits (4,000 <= 5,000); O2 needs 4,000, receipt only 3,000 -> ESCALATE

cases.title: EUR payout converted inside the limit
cases.derivation: EUR 1,000 + 12.85 fee = EUR 1,012.85 ~ USD 1,099; headroom 15,000; limit 10,000 (no receipt -> full) -> autonomous

cases.title: conversion above the autonomous limit
cases.derivation: EUR 12,012.85 ~ USD 13,034 > limit 10,000 (headroom 25,000 is fine) -> a person approves

cases.title: limit zero: every conversion needs a person
cases.derivation: any conversion > 0 -> REQUIRES_APPROVAL

cases.title: EUR wallet already covers the EUR payout
cases.derivation: EUR 2,000 >= 1,012.85 -> no conversion, cost 0

cases.title: GBP wallet covers part: convert the shortfall only
cases.derivation: need GBP 1,000 (LOCAL, no fee), have 400 -> buy exactly 600

cases.title: stress leaves exactly enough (deterministic) but no margin (probabilistic)
cases.derivation: deterministic: headroom = 10,000 - 5,000 - 2,000 = 3,000 = 3,000 -> PAY. Probabilistic: the 72h simulation draws the unexpected outflow with a lognormal size around 2,000, so landing exactly on the floor breaches it in about half the paths, far above the 5% tolerance -> a person approves. (The first hand answer missed the second rule; recorded as such.)

cases.title: zero reserve floor
cases.derivation: floor 0: cash 1,000 pays 1,000

cases.title: zero cash
cases.derivation: nothing can be paid; the plan is still a plan (escalates), not BLOCKED

cases.title: large amounts, still inside the live sandbox wallet
cases.derivation: USD 9,000,000 cash, USD 1,000,000 obligation, floor 5,000 -> PAY. (Amounts above the live wallet, e.g. USD 10bn, are BLOCKED by the live-balance check when the service is connected to the sandbox: the plan is grounded in real money.)

cases.title: confidence 90%: limit is full
cases.derivation: conf 90% >= 90% -> limit 10,000; conversion ~USD 7,734 < 10,000 -> autonomous

cases.title: confidence 40%: limit zero
cases.derivation: conf 40% <= 50% -> limit 0 -> any conversion needs a person

cases.title: priority 10 due now and priority 1 due at the horizon both fit
cases.derivation: 4,000 <= 5,000 -> both PAY regardless of priority

cases.title: cheapest obligation dropped, not the most urgent
cases.derivation: 4,000 fits; 1,500 more = 5,500 > 5,000 -> O2 cannot be funded
